claim_text: Darkness on Cuba with the grid completely down, done on purpose in retaliation because of the ties being made with Russia, and he thinks it happened by cyber though he does not know.
quote: darkness like complete grid down and this was on purpose
falsify_match: A Cuban blackout attributed to deliberate outside action.
falsify_miss: The published cause stays fuel shortage and plant failure. He says himself he does not know.

claim_text: Old alliances and friendships with Russia, with an extension cord running from Russia to Cuba under the water, a black cord like an internet cable, a secret cord deep in the water, which he says is symbolic.
quote: I see an extension cord again from Russia to Cuba and it's under the water
falsify_match: A direct Russian cable or supply line to Cuba.
falsify_miss: None laid. He marks it symbolic himself, which removes the literal test.

claim_text: The woman in Mexico is how the corruption got into power, with keys running from Venezuela to her to Cuba, people trafficked and drugs brought up through tunnels, and Venezuela will be like an Iraq if it keeps going this way.
quote: Venezuela will be like an Iraq if it keeps going this way
falsify_match: An American occupation or long conflict in Venezuela.
falsify_miss: None. The Iraq comparison is a benchmark that would be recognisable if met.

claim_text: Venezuela and Cuba are both being promised things in an alliance of outcast countries lining up with Russia, and a base being built in Cuba so close to America would be very dangerous.
quote: That's a very dangerous promising to build a base in Cuba
falsify_match: A Russian base established in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None established. Russian naval visits have resumed since 2024 but no base has been built.

claim_text: He reads that Chinese air force activity around Taiwan has fallen sharply with no fighters at all in the past week, which could signal Beijing recalibrating, and calls it the power of prayer because he saw them coming with a plan and was told to shelter Taiwan with the blood.
quote: DO YOU SEE THAT'S THE POWER OF PRAYER?
falsify_match: A sustained reduction in Chinese air activity around Taiwan.
falsify_miss: Activity resumes. Incursion numbers have varied for years, so a quiet week is within the ordinary range.

claim_text: A white shield was brought over Taiwan in the vision and a blanket extended from the water toward China as they prayed, red and white, which he compares to candy canes and a shepherd's rod without knowing what it means.
quote: I saw a white shield and brought over Taiwan
falsify_match: Nothing observable from the shield itself.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. He says himself he does not know what the red and white mean.

claim_text: He mentions the Spanish language channel, then returns to what he saw the night before: fibre optic and cables, and a black cord going across America.
quote: I saw a black cord that looked like a
falsify_match: A covert communications line disclosed.
falsify_miss: None disclosed. The cord recurs across several tellings without an event attached.

claim_text: They do not want another strike in return like a fist fight, they want a fatal blow, and it is not about wounding the eagle but destroying it, so they are waiting for a strategic plan to bring mass destruction with the reaction they want.
quote: This is about a fatal blow to the eagle
falsify_match: A mass casualty attack inside America attributed to Iran.
falsify_miss: None. Waiting for a strategic plan means any delay is consistent with the claim.

claim_text: They work out how to get greater results with less energy, communicating in old ways by telephone, with Cuba talking to Iran's people and on to the Middle East, telephone to telephone, to avoid chatter and stay under the radar rather than using the internet.
quote: I saw Cuba talking to the man talking to Iran's people
falsify_match: A Cuba to Iran covert channel disclosed.
falsify_miss: None disclosed. Avoiding chatter is offered as the reason nothing would be detected.

claim_text: He mentions praying for a named broadcaster to be radically saved and over Austin, and says to pray over a named pastor's church because he stands with Israel and there were two people there who were unstable.
quote: I saw praying over John Hegy's church
falsify_match: An attempted attack at that church.
falsify_miss: None. He says he is not trying to bring fear, which softens what he has just said.

claim_text: Wars, then shakings and earthquakes, then pestilence and plagues as birth pains, and the Lord saying that as of the 23rd of last year they entered the point of no return with the labour pains coming one after another.
quote: As of the 23rd of last year, you've entered into the point of no return
falsify_match: A measurable escalation dated from that day.
falsify_miss: No escalation. He does not say which month the 23rd falls in, which removes the date.

claim_text: Not just tremors but 9.0 earthquakes and volcanoes erupting, birth pains one after another, with major signs about to be seen and each year looking chaotic.
quote: We're talking about 9.0. Massive earthquakes coming
falsify_match: A magnitude 9 earthquake.
falsify_miss: None. There have been five recorded at 9.0 or above since 1900, so this is a rare event by any measure.

claim_text: Cars bobbing up and down the street as floods come through the city with people panicking, which he says happened last year and will happen again, then prays the president sleeps well and settles the Cuba decision in his heart.
quote: see the cars bobbing up and down the street as the floods come in
falsify_match: Major urban flooding in America.
falsify_miss: None. He notes it happened last year, which makes a repeat close to the base rate.

claim_text: He asks what the vice president is doing and what the Secretary of State is doing and what the difference is, pleads the blood over the president's mind against demonic spirits picking at his head, and says the regime of Iran will fall quickly.
quote: What is J.D. Vance doing? What is Marco Rubio doing? What's the difference?
falsify_match: A visible divergence between those two men, and a quick Iranian collapse.
falsify_miss: Neither. This names both men in the pairing he elsewhere leaves half unnamed.

claim_text: They find the enriched uranium, and he sees them going in to look for ancient artifacts with fallen angel writing in museums in Iran which they scan with AI, followed by an uptick in technological advancement as they try to open more portals.
quote: looking for ancient artifacts of a fallen angel writing
falsify_match: Reported scanning of Iranian museum artifacts.
falsify_miss: None reported. He says himself you will probably never hear that on the news, which removes the test.

claim_text: An uptick in the demonic and in the Mahdi material, and a repeated instruction to watch Israel in the middle of the night, where what he sees is worse than October 7th.
quote: Watch Israel in the middle of the night
time_phrase: in the middle of the night
falsify_match: A night attack on Israel worse than the 2023 one.
falsify_miss: None. That attack killed about twelve hundred people, which is the threshold he set.

claim_text: Hair falling out and skin melting from a chemical weapon they are trying to develop for use against Israel, affecting children, women and men, which he calls excruciating and declares will not happen.
quote: it like it melts your skin as you go
falsify_match: A chemical attack on Israeli civilians.
falsify_miss: None. He describes it and then says in the same breath that it will not happen.

claim_text: Iran is about to carry out one of the biggest retaliatory attacks it has ever done, bringing out bigger things from under the ground for a strategic blow, which he says looks nuclear to him, a cloud coming up out of the ground.
quote: I'm going to it looks nuclear to me
falsify_match: A large Iranian retaliatory strike using something unconventional.
falsify_miss: None. He supplies the nuclear reading himself rather than being told it.

claim_text: They know it is a point of no return and will summon up the mob, planning something darker than anything ever used among natural weapons, held under the ground and aimed at Israel.
quote: planning something that is darker than what we've ever seen before
falsify_match: An unconventional weapon used against Israel.
falsify_miss: None. Darker than anything ever seen is not defined, which is what makes it hard to score.

claim_text: They do not do it and do not even think about it, and even if they did it would implode on them in the middle of their own base and take out none of Israel, because everything they are planning will not come to pass and does not line up with scripture.
quote: it will implode on them in the middle of their base
falsify_match: An Iranian weapon detonating at its own site.
falsify_miss: The attack succeeds. This is the opposite outcome to the one he described minutes earlier.

claim_text: Not one missile will touch Israel, the American bases or the aircraft carriers, biological and chemical weapons will not be used against the people of Israel in Tel Aviv, Bethlehem or Jerusalem, and when they see the hand of the Lord protecting them they will be radically born again.
quote: Not one missile like that will touch Israel
falsify_match: No missiles reaching Israel or American forces.
falsify_miss: Any do. Missiles have reached Israel repeatedly since 2023, so this is a high bar he set himself.

claim_text: There is a horde of missile supply underneath the ground being held to fulfil their prophecy, aimed at taking out Israel and America, though by his reckoning ninety five per cent or more of it is about Israel and America is only in the way.
quote: there is a a horde of missile supply underneath the ground
falsify_match: A large concealed missile stockpile found.
falsify_miss: None found. Iran's underground missile bases have been publicly displayed for years, which is the base rate.

claim_text: What is under the ground is darker than anybody realises, something very bad that they have not released yet, and he asks what would cause them to push it and whether they will even attempt it.
quote: what's under the ground is darker than what anybody realize
falsify_match: The weapon being used or found.
falsify_miss: None. He asks himself whether they will even attempt it, which leaves the claim open both ways.

claim_text: He asks viewers to say where they are watching from and notes India, Kuwait, Hawaii and Asia among them.
quote: please tell us where you're from so we know where the viewers are
falsify_match: Nothing. Housekeeping.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No claim is made.

claim_text: A man goes to a family in the Middle East, probably Iran, telling relatives there is a heaven and a hell, with a swarm of family around him and women in head coverings in awe and some spooked by what they were seeing.
quote: I saw this man going to a a family in Iran area
falsify_match: Reported conversions in Iranian families through such an encounter.
falsify_miss: None reported. Nothing here could be traced to a particular family or place.

claim_text: He says there is not enough urgency, that what is happening overseas with Israel is not normal, and that what is coming with the glorious church will not be normal either because people have become desensitised.
quote: There's not enough urgency, brother
falsify_match: Nothing. Exhortation.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No event is named.

claim_text: It went through his neck area and out and he was done, with people screaming at what they had witnessed, and another bad leader brought in after him, with the Lord saying he told him it would be a window and not a door, unlike Cuba, Mexico and Venezuela which get leaders and revival over a longer time frame.
quote: through his through his neck area and went through him and went out
falsify_match: That man shot through the neck in public.
falsify_miss: He is not. The neck wound and the public setting are the specific parts.

claim_text: Iran flips quickly back to bringing in another figure like the Ayatollah, and he says the man he was shown in the vision was announced that day, that they prayed for his safety, that he would be short-lived because his life was in danger, and he saw them assassinate him.
quote: I saw them assassinate him
falsify_match: That named leader assassinated and replaced by a hardliner.
falsify_miss: He serves. He claims the announcement that day as the confirmation of the vision.

claim_text: Israel bombed Iran's airport, and he believes that before this is over they will hit the oil wells, the gas and everything, with the price of oil skyrocketing, which he says is about the petrodollar and the world market rather than American supply.
quote: they'll hit their oil wells. They're going to hit their oil
falsify_match: Israeli strikes on Iranian oil and gas production.
falsify_miss: They stay on military and nuclear sites. He marks it as his own opinion here rather than a word.

claim_text: The same passage in the overlapping window, with the oil price skyrocketing and the note that it is his opinion and not financial advice.
quote: All in my opinion. I say that. It's not a financial advice
falsify_match: Same as the preceding row.
falsify_miss: Same as the preceding row.

claim_text: Right before the ring of fire gets really active, loads of fish wash up on the shore from underwater volcanoes, which the Lord said is a sign to watch for a major earthquake, with Japan split and the mountain with the goji berries exploding.
quote: I saw loads of fish washing up on the shore
falsify_match: A mass fish die-off followed by a major quake.
falsify_miss: No sequence. Fish kills are common and are not a recognised precursor.

claim_text: Thousands of dead fish, large and small, floating on the water along a coastline he believes is the West Coast around California, and he says to pay attention to what is going on in the water because it is volcanic.
quote: I see thousands of fish dead upon the sea
falsify_match: A mass fish die-off on the Californian coast tied to volcanic activity.
falsify_miss: None. Californian fish kills happen from algal blooms most years, which is the base rate.

claim_text: He says the Lord called him on the platform to raise up a prayer army, and prays over the Chicago St Patrick's Day parade, New York City, the president's two elder sons and their crypto investments, and the Clarity Act passing the Senate and the House.
quote: I called you on YouTube to raise up a prayer army
falsify_match: An incident at the Chicago parade, or the Clarity Act passing.
falsify_miss: Neither. The parade claim is dated and the legislation is on the record.

claim_text: Cuba is next and its people will be liberated with a major revival, the dictators are coming down, the Mexican president's days are done and a better one will be brought in, and the same for the North Korean leader with a new leader raised up.
quote: THAT KIM JONG-UN'S DAYS ARE DONE
falsify_match: Changes of leadership in all three.
falsify_miss: None change. Three regime changes claimed together, which raises the bar.

claim_text: Iran is liberated and born again and on fire for God, with the underground church taking hold of the opportunity, rising up with a backbone like a crowbar and taking the land.
quote: That Iran will be born again
falsify_match: Open church growth across Iran.
falsify_miss: None. Conditioning it on the underground church means a failure can be laid at their door.

claim_text: Praying over Europe and over the boats, he says he sees war games.
quote: All over our boats. I see war games
falsify_match: Russian exercises staged around American naval movements.
falsify_miss: None. War games is broad enough that routine exercises would satisfy it.

claim_text: Russia will do for Iran what America did for Ukraine while denying involvement, on a greater scale, with its satellites and equipment, which without prayer could put American troops in harm's way and will provoke the president, with North Korea backing it because they want the oil and the rights.
quote: is what Russia is going to do with Iran in the days ahead
falsify_match: Russian targeting or satellite support for Iran against American forces.
falsify_miss: None. Russia has supplied Iran before, so what is new is the scale and the American casualties.

claim_text: He calls against the escalation with Russia and with North Korea.
quote: We call at the escalisation
falsify_match: An escalation involving both states.
falsify_miss: None. Fragmentary, and the prayer framing makes either outcome usable.

claim_text: The Lord warned about backing the dog in the corner and not underestimating the enemy from the south, the closest and southernmost point, because they have a weapon underneath there in a bunker that was given to them by Russia.
quote: They have a weapon underneath there in a bunker
falsify_match: A Russian-supplied weapon found in a Cuban bunker.
falsify_miss: None found. This is the earliest telling of the weapon under Cuba.

claim_text: Little cords running off the centre of America to each state with a telephone on the end, with Mississippi, Alabama, Georgia and Florida named, coming off fibre optic cables.
quote: each one of those are running to a state with a telephone on it
falsify_match: A covert telephone network across those states disclosed.
falsify_miss: None disclosed. He says himself he does not understand what it represents.

claim_text: A black phone attached to a little cord, not sophisticated technology but old school, coming off a fibre cable, with cords running to New York, Chicago, Atlanta and the other major cities, and something about Mississippi he cannot place.
quote: It was old school how they were communicating
falsify_match: That network found running into those cities.
falsify_miss: None found. He asks what Mississippi means and answers that he has no idea.

claim_text: Something to do with cyber, and the Mississippi River with a secret North Korean barge coming down it to get oats, from which they fired an old black and white rocket marked USSR that did not get high enough, an EMP over Tennessee and Kentucky.
quote: it said USSR on the side of it. Old school rocket
falsify_match: A missile launched from a vessel on an American river.
falsify_miss: None. A barge on the Mississippi carrying a North Korean missile is specific enough to fail cleanly.

claim_text: A scorpion with its tail curled coming up out of the water of the Gulf at the Alabama and Mississippi border and heading toward Tennessee.
quote: A SCORPION COMING UP OUT OF THE WATER
falsify_match: Nothing observable on its own.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. It can only be scored through the events he places alongside it.

claim_text: He says he sees Mark and the man over Canada.
quote: I see Mark. And the pro- the man over Canada
falsify_match: Nothing. A name with nothing attached.
falsify_miss: Nothing. Recorded because the Canadian prime minister recurs across the Canada material.

claim_text: Red flannel comes to him immediately concerning Taiwan, red and white flannel like the stripes and the white, looking like a blanket over Taiwan.
quote: It was red and white flannel and it looked like a blanket over Taiwan
falsify_match: Nothing observable from the blanket itself.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. This is the earliest telling, a day before he attaches it to the drop in Chinese sorties.
